cases.name: Lisa Gondek
cases.about: She grew up in Connecticut. She took a trip to visit a friend in Oxnard who was in the Navy in mid-1981, Oxnard Police Chief Jason Benites said. “This two-week trip changed, and she decided to stay in Oxnard,” Benites said. After moving to North Oxnard, Gondek got a job in retail and “made some friends,” Benites said.
